title: Diebold Nixdorf’s Vynamic® Transaction Middleware Recognized by Global Payments Awards
summary: Cloud-native, API-driven platform honored by World Business Outlook and PayTech Awards 2026 for helping financial institutions modernize payments infrastructure NORTH CANTON, Ohio Diebold Nixdorf (NYSE: DBD), a world leader in transforming the way people bank and shop, today announced that its Vynamic(r) Transaction Middleware solution recently received two international recognitions for innovation in payments. The company was named Best Payment Solutions Provider Global 2026 by World Business Outlook and earned Highly Commended recognition in the Best Payments System for Banks and FIs category at the PayTech Awards 2026. Vynamic Transaction Middleware is Diebold Nixdorfs cloud-native, API-driven platform designed to help financial institutions modernize rapidly, eliminate siloed systems and deliver a smooth and consistent payment experience.
